title: Clutter
doc: Destructible and decorative objects placed in levels: mesh, material, damage, effects and editor light settings.
notes: The game reads fields up to $Debris Velocity in order, then searches for $Skin: before the next $Class Name: and skips everything between (the editor-only $RFE and $Light fields live there); text between entries is skipped too.

sections.name: #Clutter
sections.doc: All clutter classes; each entry starts at $Class Name:, and #End ends the list.

fields.name: $Class Name:
fields.doc: Unique clutter class name used by levels.

fields.name: $V3D Filename:
fields.doc: Clutter mesh.

fields.name: $Debris Filename:
fields.doc: Mesh broken into debris when destroyed.

fields.name: $Debris Sound Set:
fields.doc: Impact sound set used by the debris.

fields.name: $Corpse Class Name:
fields.doc: Clutter class that replaces this one when it is destroyed.

fields.name: $Emitter:
fields.doc: Particle emitter attached to the clutter.

fields.name: $Emitter Life:
fields.doc: Seconds the emitters run (-1 for ever).

fields.name: $Material:
fields.doc: Material name (materials.tbl).

fields.name: $Radius:
fields.doc: Radius overriding the mesh radius.

fields.name: $Life:
fields.doc: Hit points (-1 for invulnerable).

fields.name: $Damage Type Factor:
fields.doc: Damage multiplier for one damage type: type name, then factor.

fields.name: $Sound:
fields.doc: Looping foley attached to the clutter.

fields.name: $Use Sound:
fields.doc: Foley played when the clutter is used.

fields.name: $Explode Anim:
fields.doc: Vclip played when the clutter is destroyed.

fields.name: $Explode Anim Radius:
fields.doc: Radius of the explosion vclip.

fields.name: $Explode Damage:
fields.doc: Damage dealt to nearby objects when it explodes.

fields.name: $Explode Offset:
fields.doc: Offset of the explosion in local coordinates.

fields.name: $Glare:
fields.doc: Glare effect on the clutter.

fields.name: $Rod Glare:
fields.doc: Rod-shaped glare effect.

fields.name: $Flags:
fields.doc: Clutter flags; an unknown flag name stops the game.

fields.name: $Screen Width:
fields.doc: Width in pixels of the monitor image (needs is_screen).

fields.name: $Screen Height:
fields.doc: Height in pixels of the monitor image (needs is_screen).

fields.name: $Use:

children.name: +radius:
children.doc: Distance from which it can be used; required after a known $Use value.

fields.doc: What happens when the player uses this clutter; "none" or other text means not usable and then +radius is left out.

fields.name: $Debris Velocity:
fields.doc: Speed of the debris when destroyed.

fields.name: $RFE Level1:
fields.doc: Editor only: first-level folder of the object in the level editor.

fields.name: $RFE Level2:
fields.doc: Editor only: second-level folder (needs $RFE Level1).

fields.name: $Light Color:
fields.doc: Editor only: colour of the light attached to this fixture.

fields.name: $Light Type:
fields.doc: Editor only: light shape.

fields.name: $Light Range:
fields.doc: Editor only: light range.

fields.name: $Light FOV Range:
fields.doc: Editor only: cone range of a circular light.

fields.name: $Light FOV Dropoff:
fields.doc: Editor only: cone dropoff of a circular light.

fields.name: $Light Algo:
fields.doc: Editor only: attenuation.

fields.name: $Light Width:
fields.doc: Editor only: width of a tube light.

fields.name: $Light On Intensity:
fields.doc: Editor only: intensity when on (0 to 10).

fields.name: $Light Off Intensity:
fields.doc: Editor only: intensity when off (0 to 10).

fields.name: $Light Dynamic:
fields.doc: Editor only: whether the light is dynamic.

fields.name: $Light Shadow:
fields.doc: Editor only: whether the light casts shadows.

fields.name: $Light Runtime Shadow:
fields.doc: Editor only: whether the light casts real-time shadows.

fields.name: $Light Offset:
fields.doc: Editor only: forward offset of the light from the prop point.

fields.name: $Skin:
fields.doc: Alternate skin: skin name, then replacement textures in order (at most 12); the game jumps straight here, skipping editor-only text.
